Question: Looking at the storage-modulus comparison in panel F4a (10.1016/j.porgcoat.2020.105876#F4a), does what it shows support the claim above?
Answer in at most five sentences.

key.answer_key: No. At 25 C the storage modulus E' ranks FTPU (~1e3 MPa) above all the blends: FTPU > FT5BE5 > FT7BE3 > FT5B0.5E5 (~1.5e2 MPa). Every blend sits below pure FTPU, so the panel does not show the epoxy-domain blends stiffening the material above the unmodified FTPU baseline (o5).
key.grading: Answer key: the audit ruling on the panel, node o5.
